geometry.positive: minimum full-foreground bounding rectangle; natural RGB and local background preserved

statistics.environment: U columns are (a_y,t,j - mean_t a_y,t,j)/sqrt(2*T*m), T=4; C_env=U U^T
statistics.paired_direction: thin-SVD inverse of U U^T + ridge I applied to mu_positive-mu_negative
statistics.class_lda: thin-SVD inverse of U U^T+V V^T+same paired numeric ridge I
statistics.CE_direction: same labeled intervention points; FP64 average class-balanced softplus of -y*(w dot a+b) plus norm(w)^2/(2D); unpenalized fitted intercept; zero-init L-BFGS-B at most100 steps, gradient infinity target1e-8, convergence recorded
statistics.CE_readout: discard fitted intercept for direction control; use main two-class mean midpoint/separation and identical Potts/renderer
statistics.CE_self_readout: raw fitted w dot unit-query+b logits, identical Potts/renderer
statistics.CE_definition_detail_for_primary_review: Pro767 requests CE own bias but writes no explicit intercept loss or self-readout scale; unpenalized intercept and unscaled logistic own-bias readout are disclosed implementation conventions, not claimed uniquely specified by the text
statistics.ref_canvas: same four paired interventions on original reference canvas, its own environmental covariance/ridge, infer on unchanged original query features
statistics.normalization: ell=2*(q*w - 0.5*w*(mu_positive+mu_negative))/(w*(mu_positive-mu_negative)); separation<=1e-8 or nonfinite triggers bound native
statistics.probability_claim: none; intervention means map to+1/-1, natural query logits not calibrated
